Strategy: Score favors the bin whose residual is closest to the mean residual of all feasible bins, so the choice tracks the current distribution rather than any absolute leftover size. It differs from Best Fit whenever the tightest bin is far from the mean. It may help by keeping the bin population balanced, or fail because the mean is a poor target when residuals are strongly bimodal.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    m = sum(bins) / len(bins)
    return [-abs(r - m) for r in bins]
```
